title: ADEPT: RL-Aligned Agentic Decoding of Emotion via Evidence Probing Tools — From Consensus Learning to Ambiguity-Driven Emotion Reasoning

layout.note: a titled grey survey box on top, then two dashed-framed example cards stacked below; each card has a full-width black vote bar over two equal lanes (grey Traditional Label left, gold Proposed Label right)

lesson: Give each category one colour and keep it from the raw votes to every derived label, so a labelling rule can be read off the chips without arrows; a grey versus gold lane pair then shows what the old rule loses on the same votes.
